headline: Names a Miami, Florida post office building after former Congresswoman Larcenia J. Bullard.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility at 10360 Southwest 186th Street in Miami, Florida, as the "Larcenia J. Bullard Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or who runs it.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2014.
